headline: Indian Government Auction Wheat Prices Rise Up to 260 Rupees Per Quintal
summary: Wheat prices in Food Corporation of India auctions rose by ₹96 to ₹260 per quintal within a week to align with open market spot prices. Successful participant numbers fell after limits were increased to 500 tonnes.
why: FCI auctions regulate domestic grain supply and agricultural food inflation in India.

impacts.name: Wheat
impacts.why: State auction pricing increases lift physical wholesale grain acquisition costs.
